title: Activity bar item
description: A view icon in the activity bar, with active indicator and optional count badge.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Codicon id, e.g. explorer-view-icon, search-view-icon, source-control-view-icon, run-view-icon, extensions-view-icon

examples.title: Items
examples.html: <vsc-activity-item icon="explorer-view-icon" label="Explorer (Ctrl+Shift+E)" checked></vsc-activity-item><vsc-activity-item icon="source-control-view-icon" label="Source Control (Ctrl+Shift+G)" badge="3"></vsc-activity-item>
